Messages

Sign in to read private conversations, edit shared guides, and send formatted messages with headings, lists, colors, and code blocks.
H’s Notes

Messages

Privacy
  • Sent text and your messaging profile are stored online. Only conversation members and the site operator can read a conversation. This is not end-to-end encrypted, so keep passwords and access keys out of messages.
  • Conversations expire after 90 days. The conversation creator can delete one sooner, and authors can delete their own messages.
  • A message can hold up to 16,000 characters, and a conversation up to 100 messages. Pasting imports plain text only, so use the toolbar for formatting.
  • Switching conversations or signing out clears an unsent draft.
Your profile

Signed-in users who know your complete sign-in email can find you and start a conversation. Your name is kept privately for up to 90 days after your last change, and your public site username stays separate.

Private conversations and shared guides. Format messages with headings, lists, colors, and code blocks. Persian text reads right to left, and code stays left to right.

        Approve access only for the conversation selected here. The connection can read pending research requests and their text context, then post one AI reply per request. It cannot read attachments or manage accounts. A connection lasts up to 30 days and can be disconnected sooner. Client names are supplied by the connecting app, so check its callback host.

        Private connections require a sign-in within the last ten minutes. Sign in again with the same owner account if needed, then approve the connection.

        Research assistant

        Ask assistant sends your question, the shared guide, and up to six recent text messages to the connected AI service. Files are excluded. Ordinary messages never reach the assistant. Replies are labeled AI and may need your review.

        Owner private tool connections

        These separate connections cannot read chat messages or files. The owner client may queue searches of published website text. The Mac runner may claim and finish those jobs. Private notes, reviewers, shell access, and account credentials remain local. Jobs wait when the Mac is offline.

          How file encryption works

          With encryption, the file contents and filename are encrypted in this browser before upload, and the passphrase is never sent to the server. Use a unique passphrase of at least 16 characters and share it through a separate trusted channel. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. The website code and your device must be trusted. Without encryption, conversation members and the site operator can read the file. Ordinary chat messages are not encrypted this way. Each file can be up to 1 MiB, with 20 files per conversation, and files expire with the conversation.
